description: This PHP class 'RequestResetPasswordController' handles requests for password reset in the OrangeHRM system. It processes incoming HTTP requests to initiate a password reset procedure, validating CSRF tokens, searching for the user by username, logging the reset request, and redirecting accordingly.

classes.name: RequestResetPasswordController
classes.description: Controller class to handle password reset requests by validating CSRF tokens, searching for user records, logging password reset attempts, and redirecting to appropriate routes.

methods.name: getResetPasswordService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ResetPasswordService instance used to manage password reset logic.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming password reset requests, validating CSRF token, searching for user, logging the request, and redirecting based on success or failure.
